children: Palm oil rises in Asian trading thanks to bargain hunting. Technical analysis suggests crude palm oil futures could remain in positive territory although momentum has moderated following the recent pullback, AmInvestment Bank says in a note. Prices are expected to consolidate with an upside bias as long as they hold above 4,900 ringgit a ton, it adds. The Bursa Malaysia Derivatives contract for December delivery is up 45 ringgit at 5,043 ringgit a ton. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
